idea: Multiply by conversion factors written as fractions equal to 1, arranged so the units you don't want cancel. For areas and volumes, square or cube the length conversion.
trap: Converting square feet to square yards by dividing by 3 instead of 9.
desmos: Desmos will multiply anything you type. Setting up which factor goes on top is the part that earns the point.

items.stem: A cyclist rides at a constant speed of 138 kilometers per hour. What is this speed in meters per second?
items.explain: 1 h138 km​⋅1 km1,000 m​⋅3,600 s1 h​=3115​ meters per second.

items.stem: Carpet costs $36 per square yard. How much would it cost, in dollars, to carpet a rectangular room that is 12 feet long and 9 feet wide? (1 yard = 3 feet)
items.explain: The room is 312​=4 yards by 39​=3 yards, or 12 square yards. (Equivalently, 108 square feet divided by 9.) The cost is 12×36=432 dollars.

items.stem: A leaky faucet drips 1 drop every 4 seconds, and 20 drops make 1 milliliter. How many liters of water does the faucet drip in one week?
items.explain: A week has 7×24×3,600=604,800 seconds, which is 4604,800​=151,200 drops, or 20151,200​=7560 milliliters. Divide by 1,000: 7.56 liters.
